name: Weatherstone Apartments
headline: Steele Properties is recapitalizing and renovating Weatherstone Apartments, a 204-unit 1981 family complex in north Aurora where every unit carries project-based Section 8. It won a 2024-cycle federal 4% credit from CHFA with $38.4M of CHFA bonds and no state credit.
why_it_matters: A preservation deal for deeply subsidized housing: the HUD contract on all 204 units now runs to 2044, and county and HUD records show the 2024 transfer and a HUD risk-share insured loan, a pattern for keeping aging Section 8 stock affordable without new construction.

status.label: Closed September 2024 (inferred from deed and HUD loan records); rehab underway from early 2025, completion not confirmed
status.detail: Arapahoe County shows a transfer to Steele Weatherstone LLC recorded 2024-09-09 for $42,251,853, and HUD shows an FHA risk-share insured loan endorsed 2024-09-04. The general contractor's $13.76M rehab began by March 2025 with completion anticipated in March 2026; no record found confirms completion.

next_step: Look for a rehab completion notice or final CHFA placed-in-service documentation, and confirm the seller on deed reception E4057962.

key_numbers.value: 204 homes, all income-restricted and all with Section 8
key_numbers.meaning: 18 one-, 168 two- and 18 three-bedroom units, all at 60% AMI under the credit; the HUD project-based contract on all 204 units runs to 2044-09-30.
No state credit; federal credit runs 10 years; amounts marked subject to change.
HUD also records a $44,642,000 FHA Section 542(c) HFA risk-share insured loan endorsed in September 2024 (CHFA as the risk-share lender inferred).
Deed price recorded by Arapahoe County in September 2024 (marked unqualified, consistent with a related-party sale, inferred); FTK's renovation contract is $13,759,700.

background.text: Steele's own page lists Weatherstone as a project-based Section 8 family LIHTC community with Steele renovations in 2008, so Steele interests are inferred to have owned it before the 2024 transfer; the September 2024 deed to Steele Weatherstone LLC is inferred to be a related-party recapitalization, and the seller is not shown in the sources found.
HUD's assisted-housing data shows the property's existing tax credit flag and a single project-based Section 8 contract covering all 204 units, expiring 2044-09-30.
The 2024 refinancing carries an FHA Section 542(c) HFA risk-share insured loan of $44,642,000 endorsed 2024-09-04, maturing in 2066.
FTK Construction Services announced a $13,759,700 renovation contract in March 2025, with CHFA as lender and completion anticipated in March 2026.
No public document found shows the deal in CHFA's 2024 competitive rounds (Round One applicants, Round Two applicants or awards).
